title: Practical Projects, Capstone and Portfolio
learningObjectives: Explain the main ideas of Practical Projects, Capstone and Portfolio.
Identify the language rules and relevant C++ constructs.
Apply the topic in a small program.
Recognize common pitfalls and safety concerns.
Test an example and justify design decisions.

understand.concept: A capstone starts with a problem, users, constraints and acceptance criteria. Plan milestones, implement incrementally, test normal/boundary/error cases and document build/run, samples, design and limitations.
understand.whyItMatters: A completed project demonstrates applied skills, planning, testing and communication beyond isolated syntax.
understand.explain: Scope the project tightly. Design data types, implement milestone by milestone, include a test matrix, README and known limitations.
